name: cboxdk/billing-php
description: PHP client for the Cbox Billing API, generated from its OpenAPI contract, with a hot-path enforcement client (leases, entitlements, features), webhook verification, pagination and typed errors.

suggest.ext-redis: Share the enforcement client's state between processes with RedisStore::phpredis()
suggest.predis/predis: Share the enforcement client's state between processes with RedisStore::predis()
suggest.ext-apcu: Share the enforcement client's state between the PHP-FPM workers of one host with ApcuStore
